Figure 1:Overview of VoxMel.Top left: Dashed arrows show the two-axis Haar decomposition.
The mel spectrogram is first split along frequency into
Frequency-Averaged Mel and a frequency residual; Frequency-Averaged Mel
is then split along time into Coarse-Mel and a temporal residual.Bottom to top: The pipeline autoregressively generates Coarse-Mel,
then predicts the temporal and frequency residuals with non-autoregressive
tiers in dependency order. The inverse transform reconstructs the mel
spectrogram, which a vocoder converts to a waveform.
